body.x: BARCELONA, Spain (AVING Special Report on 'Mobile World Congress 2011') -- <Visual News> The hottest mobile device is 'Tablet' at 'MWC 2011' which has been held in Barcelona, Spain from Feb 14(local time). Especially at this show, tablets with Google's Android 3.0(Honeycomb) unveiled in earnest.
Already Motorola 'XOOM', the first Honeycomb tablet, has been unveiled at CES 2011. At MWC 2011, 2 Korean enterprises Samsung and LG unveiled their Honeycomb tablet, 'Galaxy Tab 10.1' and 'G-Slate'.

These 3 Honeycomb tablet have something in common. They all loads not Intel 'Atom' but 'Tegra' of Nvidia, graphic card chipset manufacturer. In fact, those all showed fast running speed thanks to strong performance based on dual core. There was hardly disconnection.
However, the running style of 3 was almost same. In short, it can't be found any individuality. Nevertheless, the speed is great. It is likely that they will release them after customizing.

Through MWC 2011, Homeycomb Tablet market has been opened. But the price of Honeycomb tablets with 'Tegra' will be a burden to customers. Because it is definitely that they have higher price than tablets with single processor.
Google may expect the spread of tablets through Google but tablet is not a 'Must-have Item' dislike smartphone. Let's see how customer accepts high price.
<AVING Special Report Team for Mobile World Congress 2011: Idea K. Kim, B.J Park, Kevin Choi, Astin Jung, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Hyunkyung Shin, Sehoon Park>
